home.hero_subtitle: Dive planning, logbook and statistics application
home.hero_desc: Plan dives simply and clearly, use the online logbook with statistics and keep everything in one place.
home.features_desc: A complete web tool for recreational and technical divers.
home.feat_planner_desc: Multi-level, multi-gas planner with NDL/decompression, gas consumption calculations, profile, OTU and CNS.
home.feat_calc_desc: PPO₂, MOD, EAD, END, SAC/RMV, best mix, NDL tables and much more — free and without login.
home.feat_dives_desc: Store your dives including sites, profiles, buddies, certifications and notes. All in one place.
home.feat_gas_desc: Interactive controls. Switch languages, themes and units with ease.
home.feat_equipment_desc: Equipment tracking, service scheduling and easy assignment to dives.
home.feat_stats_desc: Your dive summaries and global community statistics.
home.cta_desc: Registration is free along with all available services.
home.why_desc: Everything a diver needs in one place.
home.perk_browser: Everything in the browser, no installation
